title: Scaffold plugins/ structure and shared templates
summary: Create the top-level plugins/ dir, per-harness subdirectories, and _shared/ templates (single source of truth for /planner routing and SessionStart notify).
description:
Establish the multi-plugin folder layout so multiple harness plugins can coexist.

## Current state
- No plugins/ dir exists.
- The /planner routing lives in packages/agent-plan/src/index.ts:plannerCommandTemplate (emitted to ~/.claude/commands/planner.md by `agent-plan setup claude-code`).
- SessionStart notify logic lives in packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts (session_start hook) but is Pi-specific.

## Work items
- Create plugins/README.md (index table: plugin × harness × status × install).
- Create plugins/_shared/README.md + planner-skill.md.in + notify-session-start.sh.in (templates with {{HARNESS}}/{{LOAD_COMMAND}} placeholders).
- Create plugins/claude-code/ and plugins/codex/ subdirectories (codex is a placeholder README only).

## Behaviors to preserve
- _shared/ is the single source of truth; plugins derive from it via sync.
- Static bundles only (no npm packaging for plugins).

## Code references
- packages/agent-plan/src/index.ts:plannerCommandTemplate — routing content to port into planner-skill.md.in.
